annotation.evidence_span: maximum value allowed by QUIC’s MAX_STREAMS
annotation.interpretation_a: The phrase refers to the highest stream ID that can be opened given the current MAX_STREAMS limit (i.e., the maximum stream ID that the server can use).
annotation.interpretation_b: The phrase refers to the maximum numeric value that the MAX_STREAMS field itself can hold (i.e., the maximum number of streams that QUIC allows).
annotation.justification: The clause does not specify whether "maximum value" refers to the stream ID or the stream count, allowing two materially different implementation behaviours.
